fields.taxable_income: The money output of Section63.TaxableIncome for the taxpayer and period.
fields.filing_status: The FilingStatus output of Section2.FilingStatusFor, converted constructor-for-constructor to Section1.FilingStatus.
fields.unemployment_tax: The tax output of Section3301.UnemploymentTax for the taxpayer as employer and the same period.

composition.factual_input: The deterministic converter emits Definitions.World, Entity, and TaxPeriod inputs for Sections 2, 63, and 3301.
composition.world_shape: Six dependency candidates, six financial facts, eight relationship facts, four employment facts, and three status facts in required fixed positions; unused positions use closed no-fact constructors.
composition.legal_evaluation: Generated Catala evaluates Section2.FilingStatusFor, Section63.TaxableIncome, and Section3301.UnemploymentTax. The evaluator converts those typed outputs into Api.TotalTax inputs; Api delegates the statutory schedule and summation to Section1.TotalTax.
